subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Project – A toy box + Sound ch
outcomes: I can make a toy box and talk about it.
I can say: I've got a yo-yo. It's red.
I can hear the ch sound in chair, cheese and chick.

tf.s: We can say: I've got a train.
tf.why: Yes! I've got a … tells what you have.

tf.s: We answer What colour is it? with a colour.
Chair starts with the ch sound.
Lion starts with the ch sound.
tf.why: Lion starts with l. Chain starts with ch.

tf.s: ch – i – n makes the word chin.
ch – o – p makes the word chip.
tf.why: ch-o-p makes chop. ch-i-p makes chip.

tf.s: Ch is made with the letters c and h.
tf.why: Right! c and h make ch.
A plane is a toy. Blue is a colour.

tf.s: Cherry starts with the sh sound.
A toy box keeps toys in one place.
tf.why: Yes! A toy box keeps toys tidy.

boxes.q: You have a yo-yo in your box. What do you say?
ch – i – p. What's the word?
What's your favourite toy in your box? (robot)
boxes.why: It's my robot tells your favourite.

boxes.q: ch – o – p. What's the word?

hunt.q: A fruit that starts with ch

mcq.q: What sound does the chop card show?
mcq.why: Chop starts with the ch sound.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with ch?
Which of these is a toy?
Which sentence tells what you have?
mcq.why: I've got … tells what you have.

mcq.q: You present your toy box. Which is a good sentence?
o: I've got a ball. It's red.
It's my turn. It's a door.
mcq.why: Say the toy and its colour.

mcq.q: Listen: ch – i – n. What's the word?
Your partner asks: What colour is it? Your train is yellow. You say…
Which word starts with ch, not sh?
mcq.why: Chick starts with ch. The others start with sh.

mcq.q: Which group of words all start with ch?
mcq.why: Chop, chain and cheese all start with ch.

mcq.q: Your friend says: I've got a robot. What can you ask next?
o: Can I go to the toilet?
